Maya: Quick question — can we run a CRM ownership sweep this week to catch accounts stuck in onboarding or missing renewal owner? We want to auto-trigger the onboarding-playbook and tag renewal-risk if healthscore < 50. cc @sam @liam :eyes:

Sam: yep. I can run a query. Do we want HubSpot or Salesforce? Also, what's the exact healthscore calc?

Maya: HS = weighted: usage(40%), engagement(30%), support-tickets(20%), NPS(10). Thresholds: <50 red, 50-70 yellow. Link to calc: https://go.redwood.ai/healthscore-specs

Priya: For automation I'd set a workflow: if owner is null OR onboarding_stage = 'started' AND last_activity > 14d THEN assign playbook 'onboarding-accelerator' and set property onboarding_owner = queue_onboarding. Also add property renewal_risk = 'onboarding-delay' if HS<50 and days_since_contract_start <90. Implementation note: use bulk API + contact dedupe. :thumbsup:

Sam: SQL I usually run in our analytics DB to find accounts missing owner:
```
SELECT account_id, account_name, owner_id, health_score, last_activity
FROM accounts
WHERE owner_id IS NULL OR owner_id = '' OR (onboarding_stage = 'started' AND DATEDIFF(day,last_activity, CURRENT_DATE) > 14);
```
Will push results to GH gist and to HubSpot list. Anyone want the gist?

Liam: Send to me and I'll map owners for renewals. Also add fields renewal_owner and renewal_tier. We should schedule weekly sweep every Monday at 9am PT. Also export to outreach for enablement. :calendar:

Maya: yes please. Sam — can you run the sweep tomorrow morning and share gist + hubspot list? Priya, can you draft the playbook steps (3-5 outreach templates + success criteria)?

Sam: On it. Running tomorrow 06:00 PT. I'll post results here and create the automation ticket in JIRA: CSOPS-4821

Onboard-bot: Scheduled sweep queued by @sam for 2026-03-21T13:00Z — will post summary after run.

Priya: Also propose we capture feedback via a short 3-question pulse sent after step 3 of playbook. Template in doc: https://go.redwood.ai/onboarding-pulse

Maya: Great. If anyone sees accounts wrongly flagged, reply with account_id and reason. Thanks team :rocket:
